title: Breaks or not sort and three letters
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Spring 1: Ta'if, Isra and Mi'raj, and sawm
source: Written for islamic-studies/y5 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: breaks or not sort and three letters)
intro: Lesson 14: The rules of fasting: intention, what breaks it and who is excused. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Niyyah
points: Intend in your heart to fast

blocks.title: Sort into: Breaks the fast / Does not break it
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Breaks the fast, Does not break it.
blocks.answer: Breaks the fast: Eating on purpose; Drinking on purpose; Swallowing water on purpose. Does not break it: Eating by mistake, forgetting; Brushing teeth without swallowing; Having a shower

head: Who
What they do
rows: Fidyah: feed a poor person each day
Not yet required; may practise part days

frame.label: Letter 1: 'I am ill.' Dear ..., Islam teaches ...
Letter 2: 'I forgot and ate.' Dear ..., Islam teaches ...
Letter 3: 'My grandad is too old to fast.' Dear ..., Islam teaches ...

keywords.def: allowed not to do something because of a good reason
making up a missed fast later
feeding a poor person for each fast someone can never make up

questions.q: Explain what a traveller does about fasting in Ramadan.
questions.a: They may leave the fast and make up the days later.
Feeding a poor person for each fast someone can never make up

questions.q: Answer three 'Ask the teacher' letters (in the portal response box): 1) I am ill; 2) I forgot and ate; 3) My grandad is too old to fast. Start: 'Dear ..., Islam teaches ...'
questions.a: 1) Rest; make up the fast later. 2) Your fast continues. 3) He gives fidyah: feeds a poor person for each day.

questions.q: Extend: why is there no special sentence for the niyyah?
Stretch: what does 'Allah intends for you ease' (2:185) teach about Islam?
questions.a: Islam does not ask more than we can bear; it is merciful.

questions.q: Aisha forgets and drinks juice while fasting. What happens?
questions.a: A) Her fast continues. Eating or drinking by mistake does not break the fast (Bukhari and Muslim).

questions.q: Who must make up missed fasts later?
Think again: why does Allah excuse some people?
questions.a: Allah wants ease for us; they make it up or give fidyah.
